Refuse a cohort that is not the one the model was developed on

Source: R/modeling_rms.R
mm_same_development.Rd

A row count cannot distinguish a cohort from a different cohort of the same size, and every basis mm_validate() reports describes the development sample. Scoring a different one and calling the result apparent is not a smaller error than scoring none.

Usage

mm_same_development(model, dev, what)

Arguments

model

A mm_model().

dev

The development rows a caller has re-derived.

what

What the caller is about to do, for the message.

Value

TRUE, invisibly, or an error.

Details

The comparison is order sensitive, because the pairing of predictors to outcome is what a c-statistic measures: the same rows in a different order are the same sample, but nothing cheap tells that apart from the same predictor rows carrying permuted outcomes, which is a different sample entirely. So a reordered cohort is refused too, and the message says so.
